description: This Kotlin source file defines extension functions for Android views, specifically for View and ImageView components. It provides utility methods to toggle view visibility and load images from URLs with placeholders.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Extension function for View that toggles visibility based on a boolean parameter.

methods.name: loadUrlOrPlaceholder
methods.description: Extension function for ImageView that loads an image from a URL, falling back to a placeholder resource if the URL is null or empty.
